description: Search extended-stay hotels, motels, and furnished housing for work travel lodging near a city, neighborhood, hospital, worksite, or landmark. Intended for travel nurses, construction crews, outage workers, and others on assignments lasting weeks or months. Resolves destination internally; verified coordinates are optional. Requires check-in and check-out dates and adult count. Returns one ordered page with full-stay prices, distances, hotel IDs, and signed propertyRef values for homes. housingType filters hotels or homes, and sort supports price or distance. A home selected by name or position in the returned list can be identified by its propertyRef.

destination.description: City, neighborhood, hospital, worksite, or landmark near the desired stay.

hotelRooms.description: Hotel rooms required; furnished homes remain whole-property results.

latitude.description: Optional verified latitude for the destination; supply with longitude.

locationLabel.description: Legacy display label; use destination for new calls.

longitude.description: Optional verified longitude for the destination; supply with latitude.

name: search_stays
title: Search extended-stay hotels and furnished housing for work travel
